# `sc` commands

```
usage: sc [-h] [--url URL] [--project PROJECT] [-o {yaml,json}]
          {whoami,kinds,get,put,delete,plan,apply,drift,import,deploy,status,promote,rollback,traffic,restart,logs,metrics,incidents,wait,compare,audit}
          ...

SimCloud command-line client

positional arguments:
  {whoami,kinds,get,put,delete,plan,apply,drift,import,deploy,status,promote,rollback,traffic,restart,logs,metrics,incidents,wait,compare,audit}
    whoami              show the authenticated principal
    kinds               list resource kinds, or show one kind's schema
    get                 get one resource, or list a kind
    put                 create or replace a resource from a spec file
    delete              delete a resource
    plan                show what applying a document would change
    apply               apply a document (prints the plan it applied)
    drift               show resources changed outside a stack
    import              adopt an existing resource into a stack
    deploy              upload a source directory and roll out a new release
    status              show a service's releases, traffic and instances
    promote             deploy the artifact serving in one environment to another
    rollback            move all traffic to an earlier ready release
    traffic             split traffic between releases, e.g. r3=90 r4=10
    restart             rolling restart of a service
    logs                show a service's logs (build, platform and app)
    metrics             request metrics measured at the load balancer
    incidents           show incidents on this project (outages and critical issues)
    wait                wait until a service is serving (or a given release is), or time out
    compare             compare one resource's spec across two environments
    audit               show the project's audit log

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --url URL
  --project PROJECT
  -o {yaml,json}, --output {yaml,json}
```

## `sc get`

```

  kind
  name

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## `sc put`

```
usage: sc put [-h] -f FILE [--if-match IF_MATCH] env kind name

positional arguments:
  env
  kind
  name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -f FILE, --file FILE  spec file (YAML/JSON), or '-' for stdin
  --if-match IF_MATCH   only apply if the resource is at this version
```

## `sc deploy`

```
usage: sc deploy [-h] [--source SOURCE] [--strategy {rolling,canary,none}]
                 [--canary-weight CANARY_WEIGHT] [--reuse]
                 env service

positional arguments:
  env
  service

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source SOURCE       directory to upload (default: current directory)
  --strategy {rolling,canary,none}
  --canary-weight CANARY_WEIGHT
                        percent of traffic for the canary (default: 10)
  --reuse               redeploy the serving artifact with the current spec
```
